in_marathi.name: Baldev
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Strong as a Mountain
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baldev हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baldev is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Bal’ meaning strength and ‘Dev’ meaning God. This name is associated with the Hindu god Vishnu, who is often depicted as Baldev or Balarama, the brother of Lord Krishna. Baldev signifies strength, courage, and protection.
